milestones.title: Rules and sign-in

Guide Google OAuth and exact redirect configuration
Verify customer sign-in and sign-out

Provide staff/test-account identities and confirm who may manage orders
Complete Google provider steps in the dashboard

acceptance: Approved business rules recorded with no guessed live fees
Customer, admin and rider test accounts can sign in and out
Customer cannot obtain a staff role

milestones.title: Secure checkout
assistantWork: Build pickup/delivery form, manual address and destination map pin
Map selected catalog choices to database IDs
Implement server-validated extras, packaging and final quote
Submit orders through the trusted idempotent RPC
Add customer receipt/history and pending-order cancellation

Test one pickup and one in-area delivery using designated test data
acceptance: Pickup has no delivery fee; delivery and packaging follow approved rules

Add accept, prepare, ready, cancel and rider-assignment controls
Complete pickup handover flow
Add menu availability and controlled open/close settings
Show status history and handle conflicting staff updates
ownerWork: Review queue with the person who handles orders
Confirm cancellation, closed-store and sold-out behavior
acceptance: An authorized admin processes both test fulfillment types

milestones.title: Rider workflow
assistantWork: Build assigned-delivery list and customer/destination details

ownerWork: Have at least one rider test on a real phone

acceptance: Two rider accounts are isolated from each other's assignments

Pickup orders cannot enter the rider delivery flow

milestones.title: Live tracking
assistantWork: Add explicit foreground GPS start/stop controls and map attribution

Show latest authorized rider location and update age

acceptance: Customer/admin see the assigned delivery's latest authorized position
GPS denial or background interruption is clearly indicated
